function.name: SET_ICON
function.abstract: It uses a graph like icon for the game window

description.p: This function allows to select the icon of game window, when the game is not running to full screen. It is necessary to call to this function before calling to , because that is the function that will create and show the window. Remember that SET_MODE initializes in a beginning the game to full screen: to initializes the game window, it is necessary to change the value of the variable before calling to .
For this function, you must use a graph of 32x32 pixels. The graph can be to 8 or 16 bits of colour, and you must not delete this graph of memory using functions like or .
It is not possible to change the icon of a window that is running, but you can call again to to active the changes.
